title: [BUG] Claude's performance significantly dropped
body:

## Bug Description
I have noticed that the performance of claude significantly dropped as of late. It cannot execute simple tasks. I was wondering if other people also experienced this?
author: YorickdeJong

top_comments.author: C4T4
top_comments.body: PLEASE DONT CLOSE THIS ISSUE WITH A RANDOM REASON. THIS PROBLEM IS REAL.

top_comments.author: timinterweb
top_comments.body: The change in experience from two weeks ago is boggling. It's insanely frustrating.

top_comments.author: aibix0001
top_comments.body: And here I thought it was my senses out of whack. Anthropic seriously needs to buy more GPUs as more and more Users use Claude. The recent advances in agentic coding and the new practise of sending huge contexts seems to correlate with the performance degradation.
